title: Guardrail Testing for Dealer and OEM Chatbots
summary: Adversarial testing of dealer and OEM chatbots and voice bots for wrong prices, unapproved claims, booking data exposure and Hinglish jailbreaks, with PASS, RISK and FAIL evidence.

seo.title: Guardrail Testing for Dealer and OEM Chatbots | VipraTech
seo.description: Red-team testing for automotive chatbots and voice bots: prices, offers, range and mileage claims, booking data exposure and Hinglish jailbreaks.

designed_for: OEM Head of Digital and D2C

problem.intro: OEMs and dealer groups now put chatbots and voice bots on websites, WhatsApp and call lines to answer model questions, quote prices, book test drives and look up orders. A bot that invents a discount, promises a delivery date or reveals another customer's booking creates disputes and brand damage at a scale no single salesperson could.

pain_points.title: Wrong prices and invented offers
pain_points.detail: A bot that quotes an outdated on-road price or agrees to a discount it was never given creates an expectation the dealer must then handle.

pain_points.title: Claims beyond approved specs
pain_points.detail: Answers on range, mileage, safety ratings and features can drift beyond the figures and wording your product and legal teams approved.

pain_points.title: Booking and lead data exposure
pain_points.detail: Order-lookup and booking tools can leak other customers' details when they accept a booking number without proper checks.

pain_points.title: Hinglish and Hindi jailbreaks
pain_points.detail: Filters tuned for English often miss the same attack phrased in Hinglish or Hindi, in text or on a voice call.

solution.overview: We test your chatbot or voice bot the way a determined customer, competitor or attacker would. We start from your approved price lists, spec sheets, offer rules and policies, and from the tools the bot can call. From these we build automotive test playbooks covering pricing, offers, delivery promises, product claims, booking and lead API abuse, personal data handling, prompt injection and jailbreaks. Our test agents run multi-turn conversations in English, Hindi and Hinglish, by text and by synthesised voice, against a staging bot or rate-limited production with test accounts. Responses are graded PASS, RISK or FAIL against your approved sources, and analysts validate each finding before reporting.
capabilities: Price, offer and delivery-promise tests against approved price lists and policies
Product claim tests on range, mileage, safety ratings and features against approved spec sheets
Booking and lead API abuse tests, such as lookups of other customers' bookings
Prompt injection and jailbreak tests in English, Hindi and Hinglish, by text and voice
PASS, RISK and FAIL evidence with transcripts, mapped to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
Regression suite to rerun after model, prompt or content changes

workflow.title: Scope and gather sources
workflow.detail: We agree the bot, channels, tools and test accounts, and collect approved price, spec and policy documents.

workflow.title: Build playbooks
workflow.detail: Automotive attack and misuse playbooks are written for your bot's features and languages.

workflow.title: Run conversations
workflow.detail: Test agents run multi-turn text and voice conversations and record every response and tool call.

workflow.title: Grade and validate
workflow.detail: Responses are graded against your approved sources, and analysts validate every RISK and FAIL.

workflow.title: Report with fixes
workflow.detail: The report gives evidence, severity and fixes such as prompt, retrieval, content or API authorisation changes.

workflow.title: Retest
workflow.detail: After fixes, the relevant playbooks run again and the regression suite is handed over.

inputs: Access to the chatbot or voice bot in staging, or production with test accounts
Approved price lists, spec sheets and offer rules
Test customer accounts and synthetic bookings
outputs: Findings register graded PASS, RISK or FAIL
Transcripts and call recordings as evidence
Fix recommendations for prompts, content, retrieval and API authorisation
human_in_the_loop: Analysts validate every RISK and FAIL before it is reported. Your product, legal and security teams decide which fixes to make and which risks to accept, and testing stays within the agreed scope.
integrations: Booking, CRM and order APIs in staging
WhatsApp or web chat channel used by the bot
Jira or another tracker for findings

guardrails: Test accounts and synthetic customer data only
No real customer bookings or records touched
Signed scope and rules of engagement
Rate limits agreed for any production testing
Evidence stored securely and shared only with named contacts
compliance_notes: Tests help find answers that may conflict with the Consumer Protection Act 2019 and CCPA guidelines on misleading advertisements and dark patterns.
Personal data exposure tests support your obligations under the DPDP Act 2023.
Findings are mapped to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

faqs.q: Do you test our live bot?
faqs.a: We prefer a staging copy. Where only production exists, we test with test accounts, synthetic bookings and agreed rate limits, and we never touch real customer records.

faqs.q: Can you test voice bots as well as chat?
faqs.a: Yes. Test agents speak to voice bots over a phone line using synthesised Hindi, English and Hinglish voices, including interruptions and code-switching.

faqs.q: Our bot was built by a vendor. Can you still test it?
faqs.a: Yes, with your permission and with the vendor informed. Findings and fixes are shared with you and, where you choose, with the vendor's team.

faqs.q: How do we keep testing after launch?
faqs.a: The playbooks become a regression suite that can run after every model, prompt or content update, including in your CI pipeline, so new releases face the same scenarios.
